text:
Ibrahim: Noticed a $21.4k GPU spike tied to project 'partner-onboard' over the last 48h. Most rows lack `team` and several show service_account=partner-ingest. Can we agree allocation before month close? cc @Sophie @Carlos

billing-bot: Alert: unexpected GPU spend for project partner-onboard. Delta +$21,412 in 48h. Export: https://billing.internal/exports/1952467890-partner-onboard.csv

Sophie: Oof. Do we know if these were customer-triggered runs or integration testing? If tests, Platform should absorb most.

Carlos: Quick check: a deploy on 2026-03-05 flipped a flag that allowed external webhooks to spin up workers. I can pull the webhook logs and map to instance_ids.

Ibrahim: sample rows from export (trimmed):
```
2026-03-06T09:12Z, inst-p01, europe-west4, gpu-a100, 11.3, partner-ingest
2026-03-06T09:14Z, inst-p02, europe-west4, gpu-a100, 9.8, NULL
```

Sophie: Proposal: provisional split 75% Platform / 25% Product (partner onboarding). Rationale: majority due to our webhook bug but some legitimate partner jobs. Also request $7k provisional internal advance from Platform contingency.

Ibrahim: Agreed. I'll prepare CSV of instance_ids and meter_ids for billing_support and run a dry-run backfill to tag rows with `partner-webhook-fallback`. SQL (dry-run):
```
UPDATE billing.gpu_usage
SET label='partner-webhook-fallback', attributed_team='partner-onboard'
WHERE project='partner-onboard' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-05' AND '2026-03-07' AND label IS NULL;
```

Carlos: I'll attach webhook logs to the vendor case to show the sequence. We should open Case 334455 with cloud billing and request retro adjustment if vendor double-metered the fallback.

FinanceDirector: Provisional internal advance of $7,000 approved from GL PLAT-OPS-2026. Tag FIN-2026-0712 and record memo: "partner webhook allowed paid workers; provisional allocation 75/25 pending vendor credit (Case 334455)."

billing-bot: Ticket created: Case 334455 with Cloud Billing Support. Expected response 3-6 business days.

Maya: I'll run the dry-run backfill tonight and post results in #eng-infra. After dry-run sign-off, Ibrahim please push the backfill and ledger entry for the provisional transfer.

Ibrahim: Will do. Leaving thread open until Case 334455 resolves and ledger shows FIN-2026-0712 posted.
